dedupe_keys.name: robobus a diverse and cross border public transport dataset

description: RoboBus: A Diverse and Cross-Border Public Transport Dataset is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by github.com. Academic datasets are an important source of information to validate and benchmark novel research concepts. In this paper we present RoboBus, a dataset recorded with a commercial bus on a cross-border public transport route between Luxembourg and France. Coverage: LU. Its keywords include public-transport, computer-vision, cross-border-commuters, mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
